posts.text: Today, a federal district court issued first ruling against Trump's new executive order on birthright citizenship. As the court rightly concluded, the new order is blatantly at odds with the Supreme Court's recent ruling in Trump v. Barbara. For more, see my analysis here: reason.com/volokh/2026/...
